children: Crypto KOL Ansem said on X that the market is still at a very early stage, and it is not too late for investors without exposure to start paying attention and planning entries. According to Odaily, he said investors who have not bought yet can set a target price range in advance, while tokens already in price discovery may offer a better entry near the breakout point, as significantly lower prices may not be available later.

title: Ansem Says Crypto Market Is Still in an Early Stage
